purpose: Deepen RIGHTS_BUNDLE_COMPLETENESS using real failures where physical delivery, nominal transfer or employment exit occurs but material control/recovery channels remain with the wrong actor. This is a search-rule refinement, not a new ontology or account-transfer business thesis.

evidence: A Xuzhou used-new-energy-vehicle buyer paid in full and completed vehicle-title transfer but could not transfer the vehicle App/account.
The vehicle still had an unresolved finance/mortgage restriction and faced remote-lock risk; normal intelligent-control use was materially impaired.
The local court explainer treated account/intelligent-control transfer as a core part of seller performance, not an optional extra after physical title transfer.
findings.interpretation: Physical title transfer can leave the old/right-holding party or financing system with material technical control. Usable ownership requires control-state migration, not only registry title.

evidence: A 2026 Kunshan case involved a game account sold for value and then repeatedly recovered by the original holder through password-reset/fraudulent appeal channels and resold.
Payment and credential handover therefore did not eliminate the original holder's superior recovery capability.
findings.interpretation: If the transferor retains a stronger recovery/reset identity than the transferee, apparent control can be revoked after exchange. Credential delivery alone is not durable control transfer.

evidence: A 2026 Nantong criminal case involved a former network technician who retained highest-privilege account credentials after leaving the company.
He remotely deleted core data and backups, causing the enterprise information system to stop and business operations to be disrupted.
findings.interpretation: Employment termination did not complete authority termination. Enterprise asset/control continuity requires explicit privilege revocation and custody transfer, not only HR separation.

evidence: Jiangsu court material shows account/store operations can carry independent economic value while platform identity, certification and user-agreement rights remain material to lawful control.

A 2026 Suzhou case concerning an authenticated platform account/store highlights that private cooperation/operation arrangements create disputes when account qualification and operating responsibility remain attached to another person's certified identity.
Other Jiangsu cases similarly show that a buyer can receive login/use credentials while the registered identity or platform relationship remains with the original account holder.
findings.interpretation: Some digital assets are not freely transferable objects; control is partly a contract/identity relationship with a platform. A transfer checklist must include platform consent/identity rules, not merely passwords and private contracts.

evidence: A 2026 judicial bankruptcy auction of software copyright expressly disclosed that the administrator had not taken custody of relevant registration certificates, software, source code or other physical/digital items and would deliver the asset as-is.
A copyright/legal right can therefore be transferable while the operational materials needed to use, maintain or reconstruct the software are absent.
findings.interpretation: Legal ownership of an intangible right is not equivalent to possession of an operable system. Transfer completeness must distinguish IP title, source/code, credentials, data, infrastructure, keys and maintenance knowledge.

search_rules_refined.name: CONTROL_CONTINUITY_AFTER_TRANSFER
questions: After sale, handover, outsourcing change or employee exit, who can still reset, recover, revoke, remotely lock, delete or materially alter the asset/service?
Which identity is authoritative to the platform/OEM/cloud provider rather than merely named in the private contract?
Have all privileged accounts, recovery channels, API keys, signing keys, remote-control roles and service-owner identities been migrated or revoked?
Can the receiver continue normal operation if the transferor disappears or becomes hostile?
search_rules_refined.relationship_to_existing_doctrine: Operational deepening of RIGHTS_BUNDLE_COMPLETENESS and VERIFIABILITY_TRANSFORMATION; not a new top-level ontology.

search_rules_refined.name: RESIDUAL_CONTROL_CHECK
search_rules_refined.pattern: nominal transfer/exit completed + prior actor retains superior technical or identity recovery channel -> receiver's control is revocable or operations remain hostage
search_rules_refined.boundary: A retained password is not by itself a market edge. Search for repeated bounded workflows with measurable loss/delay and a currently inadequate handover/control-verification route.

search_rules_refined.name: OPERABLE_ASSET_COMPLETENESS
search_rules_refined.pattern: legal/physical title + missing source/data/credential/service entitlement/maintenance knowledge -> asset exists but use-value cannot reliably transfer
